title: One Person Lab WebUI 图文安装教程
machine_boundary: Machine-readable guide manifest. Human-readable guide body is maintained in docs/guides/docker-webui-install/guide.qmd. App install contracts, release artifacts, GHCR publish receipts, shell Dockerfile, WebUI backend behavior, and live container smoke remain the machine truth.
audience: Windows x64、macOS 或 Linux x64 的 Docker/WebUI 用户；默认没有 Docker 经验。
intro: 新手主路径是准备 Docker、运行一键安装器、建立本机 WebUI 会话；页面发现 Core 未配置时尝试进入首次设置，没有自动跳转时使用左下角恢复入口，普通启动保持可用。

download.linux_macos_installer_url: exact GitHub Release asset URL for opl-install.sh resolved from the Latest Release record
download.windows_installer_url: exact GitHub Release asset URL for install-docker-webui.ps1 resolved from the Latest Release record
download.linux_macos_online_command: download opl-install.sh from the exact Release record, verify its size and SHA-256, then run ./opl-install.sh --container-webui --yes --enable-auto-update
download.linux_server_online_command: download opl-install.sh from the exact Release record, verify its size and SHA-256, then run ./opl-install.sh --container-webui --yes

publishing.pdf_engine_reason: Quarto 1.9.38 Typst Book route currently fails in the default orange-book template on local smoke; xelatex remains the stable Chinese PDF engine until the OPL Typst template is hardened.
